items.absence_reason: CAPS Grade 4 Mathematics is published in Afrikaans by the DBE as an official translation of the English authoritative document. The Tier 1 English source establishes the authoritative curriculum content. The Afrikaans translation is registered for provenance tracking but the substantive rights and authority derive from the English source. Rights policy permits may_translate and may_publish_translation, making the English source sufficient for all delivery languages.
